s.d: βολή, -ῆς, ἡ (βάλλω), [in LXX: [[genesis 21 16|Gen.21:16]] (טחה), 2Ma.5:3, 3Ma.5:26 * ;] a throw; λίθου β. (Thuc., v, 65, 2), a stone's throw: [[luke 22 41|Luk.22:41.]]† (AS)
βολίζω (βολίς, in sense of sounding-lead), to heave the lead, take soundings: [[acts 27 28|Act.27:28.]]† (AS)
βολίς, -ίδος, ἡ (βάλλω), [in LXX for חֵץ, יָרָה, etc. ;] a dart, javelin: [[hebrews 12 20|Heb.12:20]], Rec. (LXX).† (AS)
Βοός and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז), Boaz ([[ruth 2 1|Rut.2:1]]): [[matthew 1 5|Mat.1:5]], [[luke 3 32|Luk.3:32]].† (AS)
βόρβορος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX: [[jeremiah 38 6|Je 45(38):6]] (טִיט)* ;] mud, filth: [[2-peter 2 22|2Pe.2:22.]]† (AS)
βορρᾶς, -ᾶ (Attic contr. of Βορέας, the North wind personified), [in LXX for צָפוֹן ;] 1. Boreas, the North wind. 2. the north: [[luke 13 29|Luk.13:29]], [[revelation 21 13|Rev.21:13]]. † (AS)

βόσκω, [in LXX for רעה ;] prop., of a herdsman, to feed: [[matthew 8 33|Mat.8:33]], [[mark 5 14|Mrk.5:14]], [[luke 8 34|Luk.8:34 15:15]]; metaphorically, of Christian pastoral care, [[john 21 15|Jhn.21:15, 17]]. Pass., of cattle, to feed, graze: [[matthew 8 30|Mat.8:30]], [[mark 5 11|Mrk.5:11]], [[luke 8 32|Luk.8:32]].† SYN.: ποιμαίνειν, to tend, shepherd, a wider term, including oversight as well as feeding (see Tr., Syn., §xxv). (AS)
Βοσόρ see Βεώρ - ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּעוֹר), Beor, father of Balaam: [[2-peter 2 15|2Pe.2:15]] (Rec. Βοσόρ).† (AS)
βοτάνη, -ῆς, ἡ (βόσκω), [in LXX for עֵשֶׂב, דֶשֶׁא, חָצִיר ;] 1. grass, fodder. 2. green herb: [[hebrews 6 7|Heb.6:7.]]† SYN.: λάχανον, a garden herb, a vegetable. (AS)
βότρυς, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX for אֶשְׁכֹּל ;] a cluster of grapes: [[revelation 14 18|Rev.14:18]] (cf. στραφυλή) .† (AS)
βουλευτής, -οῦ, ὁ (βουλεύω), [in LXX: [[job 3 14|Job.3:14 12:17]] (יעץ)* ;] a councillor, a senator; of a member of the Sanhedrin: [[mark 15 34|Mrk.15:34]], [[luke 23 50|Luk.23:50]].† (AS)

βουλεύω (βουλή), [in LXX chiefly for יעץ ;] to take counsel, deliberate, resolve. In mid., 1. to take counsel with oneself, consider: before εἰ, [[luke 14 31|Luk.14:31.]] 2. to determine with oneself, resolve: with inf., [[acts 5 33|Act.5:33 27:39]]; with accusative, [[2-corinthians 1 17|2Co.1:17;]] before ἵνα, [[john 11 53|Jhn.11:53 12:10]] (cf. παρα-, συμ-). † (AS)

βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ (βούλομαι), [in LXX frequently for עֵצָה ;] counsel, purpose (in cl., esp. of the gods): [[luke 23 51|Luk.23:51]], [[acts 4 28|Act.4:28 5:38 19:1 27:12, 42]]; pl., [[1-corinthians 4 5|1Co.4:5;]] of the Divine purpose, [[hebrews 6 17|Heb.6:17;]] τ. βουλὴν τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, [[ephesians 1 11|Eph.1:11;]] β. τ. Θεοῦ, [[luke 7 30|Luk.7:30]], [[acts 2 23|Act.2:23 13:36 20:27]].† (AS)

βούλημα, -τος, τό (βούλομαι), [in LXX: [[proverbs 9 10|Pro.9:10]] (דַּעַת), 2Ma.15:5, 4Ma.8:18 * ;] purpose, will: [[acts 27 43|Act.27:43]], [[romans 9 19|Rom.9:19]], [[1-peter 4 3|1Pe.4:3]].† SYN.: θέλημα. (AS)

βούλομαι, [in LXX for חפץ, אבה, יעץ, etc. ;] to will, wish, desire, purpose, be minded, implying more strongly than θέλω (which see), the deliberate exercise of volition (see Hort on [[james 1 18|Jas.1:18]]): with inf. (M, Pr., 205; Bl., §69, 4), [[mark 15 15|Mrk.15:15]], [[acts 5 28|Act.5:28, 33 12:4 15:37 17:20 18:15, 27 19:30 22:30 23:28 27:43 28:18]], [[2-corinthians 1 15|2Co.1:15]], [[1-timothy 6 9|1Ti.6:9]], [[hebrews 6 17|Heb.6:17]], II Jhn.12, 3Jo.10, Ju 5; with accusative, [[2-corinthians 1 17|2Co.1:17;]] with accusative and inf., [[philippians 1 12|Php.1:12]], [[1-timothy 2 8|1Ti.2:8 5:14]], [[titus 3 8|Tit.3:8]], [[2-peter 3 9|2Pe.3:9]]; of the will making choice between alternatives, [[matthew 1 19|Mat.1:19 11:27]], [[luke 10 22|Luk.10:22]], [[acts 25 20|Act.25:20]], [[1-corinthians 12 11|1Co.12:11]], [[james 3 4|Jas.3:4 4:4]]; εἰ βούλει (cl., a courteous phrase = θέλεις, colloq.; Bl., §21, 8; LS, see word), [[luke 22 42|Luk.22:42;]] with subjc., adding force to a question of deliberation (Bl., §64, 6), [[john 18 39|Jhn.18:39;]] βουληθείς, of set purpose (see Hort, in l.), [[james 1 18|Jas.1:18;]] impf., ἐβουλόμην (= cl. βουλοίμην ἄν; Bl., §63, 5; Lft., Phm. 13), [[acts 25 22|Act.25:22]], Phm 13 (see also Cremer, 143).† (AS)
βουνός, -οῦ, ὁ (a Cyrenaїc word, Hdt., iv, 199), [in LXX chiefly for גִּבְעָה ;] a hill: [[luke 3 5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX) 23:30.† (AS)
βοῦς, βοός, ὁ, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for בָּקָר ;] an ox, a cow: [[luke 13 15|Luk.13:15 14:5, 19]] [[john 2 14|Jhn.2:14, 15]] [[1-corinthians 9 9|1Co.9:9]]" (LXX), [[1-timothy 5 18|1Ti.5:18.]]† (AS)
βραβεῖον, -ου, τό (βραβεύς, an umpire), a prize in the games: [[1-corinthians 9 24|1Co.9:24;]] metaphorically, of the Christian's reward, [[philippians 3 14|Php.3:14.]]† (AS)

βραβεύω (βραβεύς, an umpire), [in LXX: Wis.10:12 * ;] (a) prop., to act as umpire; hence, (b) generally, to arbitrate, decide (Isocr., Dem.; Lft., Col., l.with; MM, see word): [[colossians 3 15|Col.3:15;]] (with) in some late writers, to direct, rule, control (so in Col., l.with, accusative to Thayer, see word, Meyer, in l.), (cf. κατα-βραβεύω). † (AS)

βραδύνω (βραδύς), [in LXX: [[genesis 43 10|Gen.43:10]] (מההּ hith.), [[deuteronomy 7 10|Deu.7:10]], [[isaiah 46 13|Isa.46:13]] (אחר pi.), Si 32 (35):18 * ;] 1. trans., to retard (Soph., Is, l.with). 2. More frequently intrans., to be slow, to tarry: [[1-timothy 3 15|1Ti.3:15]], [[2-peter 3 9|2Pe.3:9]]. † (AS)
βραδυπλοέω, -ῶ (βραδύς, πλοῦς), to sail slowly: [[acts 27 7|Act.27:7.]]† (AS)
βραδύς, -εῖα, -ύ, slow: εἰς τὸ λαλῆσαι, [[james 1 19|Jas.1:19;]] metaphorically, of the understanding: β. τ. καρδίᾳ, assoc. with ἀνόητος, [[luke 24 25|Luk.24:25.]]† (AS)
1. slowness , (Iliad by Homer), attic 2. of the mind, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

βραχίων, -ὀνος, ὁ, [in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה ;] the arm; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, for the Divine power: [[luke 1 51|Luk.1:51]], [[john 12 38|Jhn.12:38]]" (LXX), [[acts 13 17|Act.13:17.]]† (AS)

βραχύς, -εῖα, -ύ, [in LXX chiefly for מְעַט ;] short; (a) of time; short, little: βραχύ, [[acts 5 34|Act.5:34;]] μετὰ β., [[luke 22 58|Luk.22:58;]] β. τι, a short time, [[hebrews 2 7|Heb.2:7]], 9 RV, mg.; (b) of distance: [[acts 27 28|Act.27:28;]] (with) of quantity or value, little, few: [[john 6 7|Jhn.6:7]], [[hebrews 2 7|Heb.2:7]], 9 RV, txt.; pl., διὰ βραχέων, in few words, [[hebrews 13 22|Heb.13:22.]] † (AS)

βρέφος, -ους, τό, [in LXX: Sir.19:11, 1Ma.1:61, 2Ma.6:10, 3Ma.5:49, 4Ma.4:25 * ;] 1. an unborn child: [[luke 1 41|Luk.1:41, 44]]. 2. a newborn child, a babe: [[luke 2 12|Luk.2:12, 16 18:15]], [[acts 7 19|Act.7:19]], [[1-peter 2 2|1Pe.2:2]]; ἀπὸ βρέφους, from infancy, [[2-timothy 3 15|2Ti.3:15.]] † (AS)

βρέχω, [in LXX chiefly for מטר ;] 1. to wet: [[luke 7 38|Luk.7:38, 44]]. 2. In late Gk. writers and vernac. = ὕειν, to send rain, to rain (Kennedy, Sources, 39, 155): [[matthew 5 45|Mat.5:45;]] trop., β. πῦρ κ. θεῖον, [[luke 17 29|Luk.17:29;]] impers., βρέχει, it rains: [[james 5 17|Jas.5:17;]] with ὐετός as subj., [[revelation 11 6|Rev.11:6.]] † (AS)

βροχή, -ῆς, ἡ (βρέχω), [in LXX: Psa.67 (68):9, 104 (105):32 (גֶּשֶׁם)* ;] 1. = βροχετός, a wetting (in π., of irrigation in Egypt; Deiss., LAE, 77). 2. As in MGr. (Kennedy, Sources, 153), = ὑετός, rain: [[matthew 7 25|Mat.7:25, 27]]. † (AS)

βρόχος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX: [[proverbs 6 5|Pro.6:5]] (יָד) 7:21 (חֵלֶק) 22:25 (מוֹקֵשׁ), 3Ma.4:8 * ;] a noose, a slip-knot, a halter: metaphorically, a restraint (not, as AV, R, txt., a snare): [[1-corinthians 7 35|1Co.7:35.]]† (AS)

βρυγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (βρύχω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 19 12|Pro.19:12]] (נַהַם), Sir.51:3 * ;] a biting, a gnashing of teeth: [[matthew 8 12|Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30]], [[luke 13 28|Luk.13:28]].† (AS)

βρύχω (Attic, βρύκω), [in LXX: [[job 16 10|Job.16:10]](9), Psa.34 (35):16 36 (37):12 111 (112):10, [[lamentations 2 16|La 2:16]] (חרק)* ;] 1. to bite or eat greedily. 2. to gnash, grind, with the teeth: [[acts 7 54|Act.7:54.]] † (AS)
βρύω, poët., late prose and vernac., to be full to bursting; 1. of the earth producing vegetation. 2. Of plants putting forth buds. 3. Of springs, to gush with water: [[james 3 11|Jas.3:11.]] † (AS)

βρῶμα, -τος, τό (cf. βιβρώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹכֶל ;] food: [[romans 14 15|Rom.14:15, 20]] [[1-corinthians 8 8|1Co.8:8, 13 10:3]]; pl., [[matthew 14 15|Mat.14:15]], [[mark 7 19|Mrk.7:19]], [[luke 3 11|Luk.3:11 9:13]], [[1-corinthians 6 13|1Co.6:13]], [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3]], [[hebrews 9 10|Heb.9:10 13:9]]; trop., of spiritual food, [[john 4 34|Jhn.4:34]], [[1-corinthians 3 2|1Co.3:2]] (cf. βρῶσις).† (AS)
βρώσιμος, -ον (βρῶσις), [in LXX: [[leviticus 19 23|Lev.19:23]], [[nehemiah 9 25|Neh.9:25]], [[ezekiel 47 12|Eze.47:12]] (מַאֲכָל)* ;] eatable: [[luke 24 41|Luk.24:41.]]† (AS)

βρῶσις, -εως, ἡ (cf. βιβρώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of אכל ;] 1. eating: β. καὶ πόσις, [[romans 14 17|Rom.14:17]], [[colossians 2 16|Col.2:16]] (see Lft., ICC, in l.); with genitive obj., [[1-corinthians 8 4|1Co.8:4;]] metaphorically, corrosion, rust: [[matthew 6 19|Mat.6:19, 20]]. 2. As also in cl. (Hom., al.) = βρῶμα, food: [[john 6 27|Jhn.6:27]]a, [[2-corinthians 9 10|2Co.9:10]], [[colossians 2 16|Col.2:16]] (EV, but see supr.). [[hebrews 12 16|Heb.12:16;]] metaphorically, of spiritual nourishment, [[john 4 32|Jhn.4:32 6:27b, 55]].† (AS)
βυθίζω (βυθός), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:4 * ;] trans., to cause to sink, to sink: metaphorically, εἰς ὄλεθρον, [[1-timothy 6 9|1Ti.6:9;]] pass., to sink, intrans.: [[luke 5 7|Luk.5:7.]]† (AS)

βυθός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX: [[exodus 15 5|Exo.15:5]], [[nehemiah 9 11|Neh.9:11]] (מְצוֹלָה), Psa.67 (68):22 68 (69):2, 15 106 (107):24 (מְצוּלָה)* ;] 1. the bottom. 2. the depth of the sea, the deep sea: [[2-corinthians 11 25|2Co.11:25.]] † (AS)
βυρσεύς, -έως, ὁ (βύρσα, a hide), late form for βυρσοδέψης, a tanner: [[acts 9 43|Act.9:43 10:6, 32]].† (AS)
βύσσινος, -η, -ον (βύσσος), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc. ;] made of βύσσος, fine linen: [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12, 16 19:8, 14]].† (AS)
βύσσος, -οῦ, ἡ (cf. Heb. בּוּץ), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ ;] byssus, a fine species of flax, also the linen made from it: [[luke 16 19|Luk.16:19.]]† (AS)

βωμός, -οῦ, ὁ (βαίνω), [in LXX (Hex.) for מִזְבֵּחַ, in Proph., chiefly for בָּמָה ;] 1. any raised place, a platform. 2. an altar: [[acts 17 23|Act.17:23]] (cf. θυσιαστήριον and see DB, i, 75). † (AS)

Γαββαθα (Rec. -θᾶ), ἡ, indecl., Gabbatha, the Greek transliteration of an uncertain Aramaic word (DB, see word; Dalman, Words, 7), used as the equivalent of λιθόστρωτον, stone pavement: [[john 19 13|Jhn.19:13.]]† (AS)
Γαβριήλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גַּבְרִיאֵל, hero of God), the archangel Gabriel: [[luke 1 19|Luk.1:19, 26]].† (AS)
γάγγραινα, -ης, ἡ, a gangrene, an eating sore, which leads to mortification: [[2-timothy 2 17|2Ti.2:17.]]† (AS)
Γάδ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גָּד), Gad ([[genesis 30 11|Gen.30:11 49:13]], al.): [[revelation 7 5|Rev.7:5]].† (AS)

Γαδαρηνός, -ή, -όν (Γαδαρά, Gadara, the capital of Peræa), Gadarene, of Gadara: [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28]] (Rec. Γεργεσηνῶν), [[mark 5 1|Mrk.5:1]], Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν), [[luke 8 26|Luk.8:26, 37]] Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν).† (AS)

γάζα, -ης, ἡ (a Persian word), [in LXX for גִּנְזִין, II [[esther 5 17|Est.5:17 6:1 7:20, 21]], [[esther 4 7|Est.4:7;]] גִּזְבָּר, II [[esther 7 21|Est.7:21;]] [[isaiah 39 2|Isa.39:2]] * ;] treasure: [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27.]]† (AS)
Γάζα -ης, ἡ (Heb. עַזָּה), Gaza, in OT, one of the five chief cities of the Philistines: [[acts 8 26|Act.8:26.]]† (AS)

γαζο-φυλάκιον, -ου, τό (γάζα, φυλακή), [in LXX chiefly for לִשְׁכָּה, נִשְׁכָּה ([[2-kings 23 11|4Ki.23:11]], al.), once for גְּנָזִים ([[esther 3 9|Est.3:9]]); το͂ γ., τᾶ γ., of a temple treasury, [[nehemiah 10 37|Neh.10:37]], 2Ma.3:6, al. ;] treasury: also, apparently, the trumpet-shaped chests into which the peoples' temple-offerings were thrown (DB, iv, 96; DCG, ii, 748): [[mark 12 41|Mrk.12:41, 43]] [[luke 21 1|Luk.21:1]], [[john 8 20|Jhn.8:20]].† (AS)

Γαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.), Gaius, the name of a Christian; 1. of Macedonia: [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29.]] 2. Of Derbe: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]] 3. Of Corinth: [[romans 16 23|Rom.16:23]], [[1-corinthians 1 14|1Co.1:14]]. 4. The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: III Jo 1. † (AS)

Γαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.), Gaius, the name of a Christian; 1. of Macedonia: [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29.]] 2. Of Derbe: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]] 3. Of Corinth: [[romans 16 23|Rom.16:23]], [[1-corinthians 1 14|1Co.1:14]]. 4. The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: III Jo 1. † (AS)

Γαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.), Gaius, the name of a Christian; 1. of Macedonia: [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29.]] 2. Of Derbe: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]] 3. Of Corinth: [[romans 16 23|Rom.16:23]], [[1-corinthians 1 14|1Co.1:14]]. 4. The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: III Jo 1. † (AS)

Γαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.), Gaius, the name of a Christian; 1. of Macedonia: [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29.]] 2. Of Derbe: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]] 3. Of Corinth: [[romans 16 23|Rom.16:23]], [[1-corinthians 1 14|1Co.1:14]]. 4. The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: III Jo 1. † (AS)

γάλα, -ακτος, τό [in LXX for חלב ;] milk: [[1-corinthians 9 7|1Co.9:7.]] Metaphorical, of elementary Christian teaching: [[1-corinthians 3 2|1Co.3:2]], [[hebrews 5 12|Heb.5:12, 13]]; τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γ., the rational (spiritual) genuine milk (see Hort, in l.), [[1-peter 2 2|1Pe.2:2]] (in support of AV, milk of the word, see ICC, in l.).† (AS)
Γαλάτης, -ου, ὁ (originally syn. with cl. Κέλτης; cf. 1Ma.8:2, and see next word), a Galatian: [[galatians 3 1|Gal.3:1.]]† (AS)

Γαλατία, -ας, ἡ, Galatia; 1. a gentilic region in Asia Minor, settled by Gauls (iii/B.C). 2. A Roman Province which included this region (DB, ii, 85ff.): [[1-corinthians 16 1|1Co.16:1]], [[galatians 1 2|Gal.1:2]], [[2-timothy 4 10|2Ti.4:10]] (T, Tr., mg., Γαλλίαν), [[1-peter 1 1|1Pe.1:1.]] † (AS)
Γαλατικός, -ή, -όν (see previous word), Galatian, belonging to Galatia: [[acts 16 6|Act.16:6 18:23]].† (AS)
γαλήνη, -ης, ἡ, a calm: [[matthew 8 26|Mat.8:26]], [[mark 4 39|Mrk.4:39]], [[luke 8 24|Luk.8:24]].† (AS)

Γαλιλαία, -ας, ἡ (Heb. הַגָּלִיל, the circle, district), Galilee, the name of the northern region of Palestine in NT times: Γ. τῶν ἐθνῶν, [[matthew 4 15|Mat.4:15]] (LXX); θάλασσα τῆς Γ., [[matthew 15 29|Mat.15:29]] (cf. [[john 6 1|Jhn.6:1]]). (AS)

Γαλιλαία, -ας, ἡ (Heb. הַגָּלִיל, the circle, district), Galilee, the name of the northern region of Palestine in NT times: Γ. τῶν ἐθνῶν, [[matthew 4 15|Mat.4:15]] (LXX); θάλασσα τῆς Γ., [[matthew 15 29|Mat.15:29]] (cf. [[john 6 1|Jhn.6:1]]). (AS)
Γαλλίων, -ωνος, ὁ, Gallio, proconsul of Achaia: [[acts 18 12|Act.18:12, 14 17]].† (AS)
Γαμαλιήλ, ὁ (Heb. גַּמְלִיאֵל), Gamaliel the elder, a Pharisee and Doctor of the Law: [[acts 5 34|Act.5:34 22:3]].† (AS)

γαμέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: [[esther 10 3|Est.10:3]], 2Ma.14:25, 4Ma.16:9 * ;] to marry; 1. of the man, to marry, take to wife (ducere): absol., [[matthew 19 10|Mat.19:10 22:25, 30 24:38]], [[mark 12 25|Mrk.12:25]], [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27, 20:34, 35]], [[1-corinthians 7 28|1Co.7:28, 33]]; with accusative: [[matthew 5 32|Mat.5:32 19:9]], [[mark 6 17|Mrk.6:17 10:11]], [[luke 14 20|Luk.14:20 16:18]]. 2. Of the woman, (a) mid. (and in late writers, pass.), to give oneself in marriage, marry (nubere): [[1-corinthians 7 39|1Co.7:39;]] (b) in Hellenistic (M, Pr., 159), act. (as of the man), to marry: absol., [[1-corinthians 7 28|1Co.7:28, 34]] [[1-timothy 5 11|1Ti.5:11, 14]]. with accusative, [[mark 10 12|Mrk.10:12.]] 3. Of both sexes: absol., [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3]], [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9, 10 36]]. † (AS)

γαμίζω (γάμος), to give in marriage, a daughter: [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38.]] Pass., [[matthew 22 30|Mat.22:30 24:38]], [[mark 12 25|Mrk.12:25]], [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27 20:35]] (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).† (AS)

γάμος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX for מִשְׁתֶּה ;] 1. a wedding, esp. a wedding-feast: [[matthew 22 8|Mat.22:8, 10 11, 12]], [[john 2 1|Jhn.2:1-3]], [[revelation 19 7|Rev.19:7]], 9; pl. (Field, Notes, 16), [[matthew 22 2|Mat.22:2-4, 9 25:10]], [[luke 12 36|Luk.12:36 14:8]]. 2. marriage: [[hebrews 13 4|Heb.13:4]] (Cremer, 666). † (AS)

γάρ, co-ordinating particle, contr. of γε ἄρα, verily then, hence, in truth, indeed, yea, then, why, and when giving a reason or explanation, for, the usage in NT being in general accord with that of cl.; 1. explicative and epexegetic: [[matthew 4 18|Mat.4:18 19:12]], [[mark 1 16|Mrk.1:16 5:42 16:4]], [[luke 11 3|Luk.11:3]]o, [[romans 7 1|Rom.7:1]], [[1-corinthians 16 5|1Co.16:5]], al. 2. Conclusive, in questions, answers and exclamations: [[matthew 9 5|Mat.9:5 27:23]], [[luke 9 25|Luk.9:25 22:27]], [[john 9 30|Jhn.9:30]], [[acts 8 31|Act.8:31 16:37 19:35]], [[romans 15 26|Rom.15:26]], [[1-corinthians 9 10|1Co.9:10]], [[philippians 1 18|Php.1:18]] (Ellic., in l.), [[1-thessalonians 2 20|1Th.2:20]], al. 3. Causal: [[matthew 1 21|Mat.1:21 2:2, 5, 6, 3:23]], [[mark 1 22|Mrk.1:22, 9:6]], [[luke 1 15|Luk.1:15, 18]], [[john 2 25|Jhn.2:25]], [[acts 2 25|Act.2:25]], [[romans 1 9|Rom.1:9, 11]], [[1-corinthians 11 5|1Co.11:5]], [[revelation 1 3|Rev.1:3]], al.; giving the reason for a command or prohibition, [[matthew 2 20|Mat.2:20 3:9]], [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11]], [[colossians 3 3|Col.3:3]], [[1-thessalonians 4 3|1Th.4:3]], al.; where the cause is contained in an interrog. statement, [[luke 22 27|Luk.22:27]], [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3 4:3]], [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]]; καὶ γάρ, for also, [[mark 10 45|Mrk.10:45]], [[luke 6 32|Luk.6:32]], [[1-corinthians 5 7|1Co.5:7]], al. id. as in cl. = etenim, where the καί loses its connective force (Bl., §78, 6; Kühner 3, ii, 854f.), [[mark 14 70|Mrk.14:70]], [[luke 1 66|Luk.1:66 22:37]], [[2-corinthians 13 4|2Co.13:4]]. The proper place of γάρ is after the first word in a clause, but in poets it often comes third or fourth, and so in late prose: [[2-corinthians 1 19|2Co.1:19.]] Yet "not the number but the nature of the word after which it stands is the point to be noticed" (see Thayer, see word). (AS)

γαστήρͅ, -τρός, ἡ, [in LXX for בֶּטֶן, ἐν γ. ἔχειν for הרה, ἐν γ. λαμβάνειν for חרה ;] 1. the belly: metaphorically, a glutton, [[titus 1 12|Tit.1:12.]] 2. the womb: ἐν γ. ἔχειν, to be with child, [[matthew 1 18|Mat.1:18, 23]]" (LXX) 24:19, [[mark 13 17|Mrk.13:17]], [[luke 21 23|Luk.21:23]], [[1-thessalonians 5 3|1Th.5:3]], [[revelation 12 2|Rev.12:2]]; εν γ. συλλαμβ., to conceive, [[luke 1 31|Luk.1:31.]] † (AS)

γε, enclitic postpositive particle, rarer in κοινή than in cl., giving special prominence to the word to which it is attached, distinguishing it as the least or the most important (Thayer, see word), indeed, at least, even (but not always translatable into English); 1. used alone: [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8 18:5]] [[romans 8 32|Rom.8:32]]. 2. More frequently with other particles: αλλά γε, [[luke 24 21|Luk.24:21]], [[1-corinthians 9 2|1Co.9:2]]; ἄρα γε, [[matthew 7 20|Mat.7:20 17:26]], [[acts 17 27|Act.17:27]]; ἆρά γε, [[acts 8 30|Act.8:30;]] εἴ γε (Rec. εἴγε), [[2-corinthians 5 3|2Co.5:3]], [[galatians 3 4|Gal.3:4]], [[ephesians 3 2|Eph.3:2 4:21]], [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23]] (see Meyer, Ellic., on Ga, Eph, ll. with; Lft., on Ga, Col, ll. with); εἰ δὲ μήγε, following an affirmation, [[matthew 6 1|Mat.6:1]], [[luke 10 6|Luk.10:6 13:9]]; a negation, [[matthew 9 17|Mat.9:17]], [[luke 5 36|Luk.5:36, 37 14:32]], [[2-corinthians 11 16|2Co.11:16]]; καί γε (Rec. καίγε, cl. καὶ . . . γε), [[luke 19 42|Luk.19:42]] (WH om.), [[acts 2 18|Act.2:18 17:27]]; καίτοιγε (L καίτοι γε, Tr. καί τοι γε), [[john 4 2|Jhn.4:2;]] μενοῦνγε (see see word); μήτι γε, see: μήτι; ὄφελόν, [[1-corinthians 4 8|1Co.4:8.]] † (AS)
Γεδεών, ὁ, indecl. in LXX and NT, in FlJ, Ant., see 6, 3 and 4 -ῶνος (Heb. גִּדְעוֹן), Gideon (Jdg.6-8): [[hebrews 11 32|Heb.11:32]].† (AS)

γέεννα (γέενα, [[mark 9 45|Mrk.9:45]], Rec.), -ης, ἡ (perh. through Aram. גֵּיהִנָּם, from Heb. גֵּי הִנֹּם, [[nehemiah 11 30|Neh.11:30;]] גֵּי בֶּן־הִנֹּם, [[john 18 16|Jhn.18:16;]] גֵּי בּנֵי־הִנֹּם, [[2-kings 23 10|4Ki.23:10;]] valley of (the son, sons of) lamentation); [in LXX the nearest approach to γ. is γαίεννα, [[joshua 18 16|Jos.18:16]] (Γαὶ Ὀννόμ, A), elsewhere φάραγξ Ὀνόμ ([[joshua 15 8|Jos.15:8]], al.), V. Swete on [[mark 9 43|Mrk.9:43]] ;] Gehenna, a valley W. and S. of Jerusalem, which as the site of fire-worship from the time of Ahaz, was desecrated by Josiah and became a dumping-place for the offal of the city. Later, the name was used as a symbol of the place of future punishment, as in NT: [[matthew 5 29|Mat.5:29]], [[matthew 10 28|; 10:28]], [[mark 9 43|Mrk.9:43, 45 47]], [[luke 12 5|Luk.12:5]], [[james 3 6|Jas.3:6]]; γ. τ. πυρός, [[matthew 5 22|Mat.5:22 18:19]], prob. with ref. to fires of Moloch (DB, ii, 119b); υἱὸς γεέννης, [[matthew 23 15|Mat.23:15;]] κρίσις γεέννης, 23:33.† (AS)

Γεθσημασεί (Rec. -νῆ, LTr. -νεῖ) indecl. (Heb. גֵּת שְׁמָנִי, oil-press), Gethsemane: called in [[john 18 1|Jhn.18:1]] a κῆπος, but named only in [[matthew 26 36|Mat.26:36]], [[mark 14 32|Mrk.14:32]].† (AS)
γείτων, -ονος, ὁ, ἡ (γῆ), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכֵן ;] a neighbour: [[luke 14 12|Luk.14:12 15:6, 9]] [[john 9 8|Jhn.9:8]].† (AS)
γελάω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for צחק, שׂחק ;] to laugh: [[luke 6 25|Luk.6:25;]] fut., γελάσω) (M, Pr., 154), ib. 21 (cf. κατα-γελάω).† (AS)
γέλως, -ωτος, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for שְׂחוֹק ;] laughter: [[james 4 9|Jas.4:9.]]† (AS)

In late writers, generally (MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), with accusative, before genitive, [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[john 2 7|Jhn.2:7 6:13]], [[revelation 15 8|Rev.15:8]]; ἀπό, [[luke 15 16|Luk.15:16]], Rec. Generally (Plat., al.), (a) with genitive of thing(s): [[matthew 23 27|Mat.23:27]], [[luke 11 39|Luk.11:39]], [[romans 3 14|Rom.3:14]]" (LXX), [[revelation 4 6|Rev.4:6, 8 5:8 15:7 17:3]] (Rec.) 4 21:9 (b) before ἐκ: [[matthew 23 25|Mat.23:25;]] (with) with accusative of thing(s) (called a solecism in WM, 251; Bl., §36, 4), as in later Gk. from Byz. to Mod. times (Jannaris, Gr., 1319): [[revelation 17 3|Rev.17:3.]] † (AS)

γενεαλογέω, -ῶ (γενεά, λέγω), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 5 1|1Ch.5:1]] (יחשׁ)* ;] to trace ancestry, reckon genealogy; pass., before ἐκ: [[hebrews 7 6|Heb.7:6.]]† (AS)
